# Prompt stress-test sources

Invented recipe sources for testing `docs/AI-TEMPLATE.md`. Each file is a plain-text
rendering of what a photo would show; `{…}` are stage directions for visual features
(smudges, crossed-out text, margin notes, other ink, torn corners). Nothing here comes
from the private vault: people, book and magazine titles, site names and user names are
made up, and URLs use `example.com`.

One line per file: the hard cases a transcription should be checked against.

- `01-tarte-aux-pommes-pate-brisee.txt` — pâte brisée sub-recipe on the back of the same card (two fences + `recipe:`), "ou acheter une croûte du commerce" (`buy_instead`), graisse Crisco (brand vs name), range "6 à 8 pommes", "une pincée", "un bon morceau de beurre" (no qty, not `to_taste`), two oven temps 425 then 350, time range 35–45 min, overwritten digit 30/20, yield not servings.
- `02-tourtiere-tante-gisele.txt` — Christmas dish attributed to "ma tante Gisèle" (`source.author`), "1 ou 2 oignons" (qty range), "2-3 patates", "sel, poivre au goût" (two `to_taste` entries), smudged word with alternate reading (girofle / gingembre `[?: …]`), pastry on another card (`recipe:` → W306), oven step with no time (must not invent), "Variante: remplacer le porc par du veau", margin note, uncertain year.
- `03-boulettes-sauce-brune.txt` — sauce from another card ("voir l'autre carte", doubled), ditto marks under "c. à thé", "ingr." abbreviation, uncertain oven digit 325/375, "un peu de beurre" only in the steps, "Servir avec patates pilées et petits pois" (suggestion with no ingredients → Notes), author's margin remark.
- `04-livre-soupe-aux-pois.txt` — cookbook page with invented title, publisher and page 142, dual units "2 t. (500 ml)" (metric in qty, cup in `alt`), "1 lb / 450 g", "boîte (796 ml)" size in note, optional ingredient ("facultatif"), servings range 8–10, times with soak ("1 nuit") and range 2 h 30 à 3 h, "branche de céleri" = stalk, printed tip → Notes, pencil annotation contradicting the print.
- `05-web-pulled-pork.txt` — English printed web page with invented URL and user name, `lang: en` with T / t (tbsp / tsp), "1 bottle (18 oz)", "3 to 4 lbs" range inside a parenthesis, cook range 8–10 hrs plus HIGH alternative, servings 6–8, optional coleslaw, buns with no amount, ad block to ignore, handwritten FR/EN notes on the printout (oven 300 alternative).
- `06-card-two-recipes-english.txt` — two recipes on one card (two fences), English abbreviations c. / t. / "b. powder" / "soda" / "ingred.", oleo, "(or dates)" → `or:`, uncertain words buttermilk / sour milk and 1/2 vs 1/3, ditto under "c.", "pinch salt", "a squeeze of lemon", "Makes 12" and pan size → `yield`, attribution to "Aunt Margaret".
- `07-magazine-beef-casserole-english.txt` — English magazine clipping with a truncated header (partial name and year: must not guess), no author, dual imperial/metric units throughout, can "10 oz / 284 ml", "375°F (190°C)", optional garnish group, serving tip with no ingredients, torn last line (`[illisible]` / incomplete), green pepper.
- `08-poulet-a-la-king-mixte.txt` — mixed French/English card (pick one `lang`, keep wording), "beurre (or oleo)" → `or:`, piment vert, "1 can cream of chicken soup", "1 petit pot" = jar with note, "salt & pepper au goût", crossed-out sherry replaced by vin blanc, margin addition "ou sur toasts", attribution to a neighbour, "Serves 6".
- `09-carte-sans-titre-macaroni.txt` — no title (make one, marked `[+]`), torn corner with illegible fragment, "céleri" with no quantity, "un peu de sucre", crossed-out line to exclude, graisse de bacon only in the steps, sel/poivre only in the steps, coffee stain hiding a word ("orig…" → `[?]`, never guessed silently), oven with no time, fèves jaunes margin note mentioning a relative.
- `10-pouding-chomeur-sirop.txt` — chopine as a unit (`pint`), crème 35% with the percentage rewritten over 15, crossed-out "1/4 t. oléo" replaced by beurre, "2-3 t. farine" range plus margin "2 t. suffit!", "1 pincée", uncertain 40/45 in a time range, pan 9x13, serving suggestion with crème glacée, cost note in margin, "Variante" written at the bottom.
- `11-feves-au-lard.txt` — "livre" spelled out, fèves (beans, not broad beans), "un peu de ketchup" with pencil "ou sauce chili" → `or:`, sel/poivre, water with no amount, low oven 250 with cook 6–8 h, uncertain 30/20, pot de grès (a dish, not a jar unit), partly faded family name in margin (uncertain reading).
- `12-roti-de-palette-oignon.txt` — typed carbon copy, enveloppe de soupe à l'oignon (`packet`), boîte de crème de champignons, "1/2 bouteille" with bière crossed out and Coke written over it, sac (`bag`), "6-8 patates", "c. à soupe" and "c. à s." both tbsp, "3 à 4 lb" range, cook 3 h à 3 h 30 or mijoteuse 8 h, handwritten piment vert addition, uncertain servings 8/6.
- `13-sucre-a-la-creme.txt` — author with an illegible surname ("Th…" or "Ch…"), can of Carnation with no size (brand kept, no invented ml), "un bon morceau de beurre", smudged quantity 2 or 3, noix with no quantity added later, coffee stain over a word, candy thermometer 234° with uncertain digit (not an oven temperature), no servings, 8x8 pan, underlined warning → Notes.
- `14-web-ketchup-aux-fruits.txt` — French printed web page with invented site, `example.com` URL and user name, pinte as a unit (`qt`) with "environ 12" note, piments verts and rouge, "branches de céleri", dual units, épices à marinades in cheesecloth, "2 c. à soupe gros sel", cook "1 h à 1 h 30" → range, yield "environ 6 pots de 500 ml", author's note, handwritten substitution and yield annotations.
- `15-pate-au-saumon-sauce-aux-oeufs.txt` — "do" ditto marks under "c.t.", "c.s." / "c.t." abbreviations, "1 grosse boîte (7 1/2 oz)" with a faint fraction, pastry "ou acheter une croûte du commerce", serving suggestion sauce aux oeufs with its own ingredients on the back (optional group + `###` sub-heading), ditto under "c.s.", betteraves suggestion, time range 30–40 min, "Vendredi saint" note.
